records.issue_text: [ADVISORY] ensure_embeddable relies on the HTTP Referer header for host authorization and sets X-Frame-Options to the non-standard value 'ALLOWALL'. Requests with a spoofed or absent Referer are rejected even from the legitimate embedding host (some browsers strip Referer on downgrade or private mode), and 'ALLOWALL' is not a spec value — browsers that don't recognize it ignore the header entirely while browsers that strictly parse CSP-adjacent frame directives treat the invalid value unpredictably, so the framing posture differs per browser rather than by design.

records.issue_text: [BUG] `i.content.scrub` raises NoMethodError when a feed item has no content element (Atom entries with only `<summary>`, plain RSS 2.0 items with only `<description>`), and the whole `rss.items.each` loop aborts on the first such item. One malformed/short item anywhere in the feed stops processing of every subsequent item in that poll — all later articles are silently dropped while the job 'succeeds'; with `retry: false` the work is lost until the next hour and then fails the same way, so the tail of the feed is never imported.
records.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, the loop does `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` inside `rss.items.each` with no nil-guard. If a feed item lacks `content`, `i.content` will be `nil` and calling `scrub` will raise `NoMethodError` (`nil.scrub`). The job is configured with `sidekiq_options retry: false`, so a single such item would cause the scheduled poll run to fail and not process subsequent items in that run.

records.issue_text: [BUG] `fetch_http` crashes with NoMethodError on nil when `SiteSetting.embed_by_username` is blank, because `.downcase` is called before the blank check that PollFeed's `execute` performs but this path does not. With embeddable_host set but embed_by_username blank (a configuration that the /embed/best endpoint's `ensure_embeddable` filter does not reject), the RetrieveTopic job dies with an unhandled exception; the user's browser sits on the loading page and reloads every 30s forever with no error ever surfaced.
records.rationale: Verified in `lib/topic_retriever.rb` `fetch_http`: `User.where(username_lower: SiteSetting.embed_by_username.downcase).first` calls `.downcase` unconditionally, so `SiteSetting.embed_by_username` being `nil`/blank will raise `NoMethodError`. Unlike `Jobs::PollFeed#execute`, which guards with `SiteSetting.embed_by_username.present?`, `TopicRetriever` has no such guard. `EmbedController#best` can enqueue `Jobs::RetrieveTopic` when no embed exists, and `ensure_embeddable` only validates `embeddable_host`/referer host, not `embed_by_username`, so this misconfiguration can crash the background job

records.issue_text: [ADVISORY] The origin check uses substring containment (`discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1`), and the resize handler is the only feedback channel for iframe height. Any origin that is a substring of the Discourse URL (e.g. a discourseUrl of `http://forum.evil.com` accepts messages from origin `http://evil.com`... more precisely a page hosted at an origin that appears as a substring of discourseUrl) can drive the iframe's height arbitrarily; and if the inner page's postMessage never fires (blocked, slow), the iframe stays at default height with content clipped and no error shown. The containment weakness is primarily Security's; the silent stuck-height is the runtime-reliability cost.

records.issue_text: [ADVISORY] On the update path, `embed.update_column(:content_sha1, content_sha1)` runs after `revisor.revise!` without checking its return value, and `revise!` returns false without raising when the revision doesn't happen. If the revise fails or is skipped (e.g. post record soft-deleted, save fails), the new sha1 is committed anyway, so the changed content is permanently lost — the next poll compares against the updated sha1 and considers the stale post current, a silent dropped update reported as success.
records.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.import` update path, when `content_sha1 != embed.content_sha1`, it unconditionally calls `revisor.revise!(...)` and then unconditionally does `embed.update_column(:content_sha1, content_sha1)` (see `app/models/topic_embed.rb`). The diff shows `PostRevisor#revise!` can return `false` early (`return false if not should_revise?` in `lib/post_revisor.rb`) without raising, so the embed’s `content_sha1` can be updated even when the post revision is skipped, causing future polls to think the post is up-to-date while it is stale.

records.issue_text: [ADVISORY] `import_remote` calls `open(url).read` with no timeout and no size cap on a URL that originates from the RSS feed or the request parameter path. A large or slow article page (or a feed-entry link pointing at a huge file) is read fully into memory and read for as long as the socket stays open, blocking the RetrieveTopic/PollFeed worker — unbounded download with no timeout on the background request path.
records.rationale: The diff adds background-fetching code paths that do unbounded network reads with no timeout/size cap.
